# parameter entity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:parameterEntity`](gmeow-parameterEntity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/parameterEntity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The bound entity for IRI-valued bindings. Range intentionally open. A parameter carries exactly one of [`parameterValue`](gmeow-parameterValue.md) / [`parameterEntity`](gmeow-parameterEntity.md) (SHACL).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionParameter.md) -> `?`; functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:parameterEntity`](gmeow-parameterEntity.md) from [`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionParameter.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionParameter.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a parameter to an entity for IRI-valued bindings — 'jurisdiction = ex:canada'.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for a literal binding (that is [`gmeow:parameterValue`](gmeow-parameterValue.md)) and avoid carrying both — a parameter holds exactly one of the two (SHACL).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:parameterEntity`](gmeow-parameterEntity.md) once per entity-valued [`gmeow:ConditionParameter`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionParameter.md); switch to [`gmeow:parameterValue`](gmeow-parameterValue.md) when the binding is a literal.

### Examples

- ex:p2 [`gmeow:parameterEntity`](gmeow-parameterEntity.md) ex:canada.
